irregularities.finding: Uniqueness gate (protocol S1, strict reading): candidate dot overlap within 3px exceeds 70% against three registry rasters — 13gems lattice-s5 null (0.9959; 206,895 dots on a ~5px lattice, so any candidate is ~100% within 3px by construction), gems10 ctx-ridge (0.8783; 174,232 positive px, continuous ridge), gems10 dotted-ridge (0.8206; 69,281 dots) and 8GEMSDOE Hedge-v2 (0.7077; 227,507 positive px). Against every operating-point-comparable dotted submission (37k-46k dots: d2.8 family, H32 family, h33-2-b2 winner) overlap is 0.397-0.497 and surface Spearman |rho| <= 0.224 everywhere.
irregularities.action_taken: H85-Conduit E3 (37,513 dots) reduced overlap below 0.70 on ALL 35 real model rasters in the fleet (gems10-ctx 0.6168, gems10-dotted 0.6163, 8GEMSDOE 0.5465, h33-2-b2 0.4532; max non-saturating = 0.6249). The sole remaining >0.70 entry (13gems lattice-s5, 0.9967) is certified by unmodified gems57.uniqueness.saturation_certificate() as covering 99.8702% of all allowed Nevada pixels (5Z^2 covering radius sqrt(8)=2.8284<3 px).
